- Initial release of the solvea-chat skill for integrating OpenClaw channels with Solvea Web App AI customer service.
- Provides scripts to send user messages or manage session state via the Solvea chat API, supporting both normal messaging and session resets.
- Includes guided setup script for environment, API credentials, and OpenClaw channel binding.
- Offers auto session management, handling new/returning users and session reset/expiry.
- Delivers clear output and error handling for different customer service scenarios.
